entries.53abfbf1dcc9592a: This is a reportable segment in which Qingdao ShoEi Foods Co., Ltd. and Yanji ShoEi Foods Co., Ltd., the production bases in China, process and manufacture confectionery raw materials and dried fruits, export them to the company and sell them within China and Hong Kong. Shanghai ShoEi International Trade Co., Ltd. and Hong Kong Shoei International Trading Co., Ltd. mainly purchase dried fruits from overseas and are responsible for sales in China and Hong Kong. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥9,969 million.
entries.5d5fbd7b89c3a2be: A food company that purchases food ingredients for the confectionery and bakery industries, processes, manufactures, and sells them, and also handles retail products such as confectionery and dried fruit.
entries.8c26b066f4d2362d: This is a reportable segment in which Qingdao ShoEi Foods Co., Ltd. and Yanji ShoEi Foods Co., Ltd., the production bases in China, process and manufacture confectionery raw materials and dried fruits, export them to the company and sell them within China and Hong Kong.
entries.b75dd41183febf21: This is a reportable segment consisting of the company and its domestic subsidiaries.
entries.bc2abe01877cee56: This is a reportable segment consisting of the company and its domestic subsidiaries. It purchases products and raw materials from Japan and overseas and sells them together with products processed and manufactured by its production subsidiaries. It includes ShoEi Delicy Co., Ltd., which manufactures confectionery, KYOMARON Co., Ltd., which processes and manufactures confectionery raw materials and dried fruits, and Tsukuba Milk Industry Co., Ltd., which processes dairy products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥108,381 million.
entries.d749090e83e4326a: This is a reportable segment comprising ShoEi Foods (U.S.A.), Inc. It purchases dried fruits within the United States and exports them to the company and to the Group's companies in China. It also purchases, processes and sells walnuts, purchases and sells prunes, operates farms growing prunes, walnuts and almonds, and imports and sells dried fruits. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥6,547 million.
entries.f1f89815e5d2aca4: This is a reportable segment comprising ShoEi Foods (U.S.A.), Inc.
